Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN
A B Constitution of India, 1950 - Articles 136 and 142 - 2G Spectrum Scam Case -Day-to-day trial - Orders passed by Supreme Court in exercise of powers conferred u/Arts. 136 C and 142 of the Constitution, while monitoring the investigation of 2G related cases - If liable to be recalled - Held: The the impugned orders was for larger public interest and for speedy trial, that too on day-to­ day basis which is reflected not only in the various provisions D of the Prevention of Corruption Act, but also falls within the realm of judicial accountability - No reason to lay down any guidelines
Decision Date : 03-09-2013 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 548/2012 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
